query_analysis.original_query: The liquid level in our three-phase separator is fluctuating, causing downstream instability. How can we diagnose and resolve this issue?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the root causes of liquid level fluctuations in a three-phase separator, focusing on identifying mechanisms causing downstream process instability and developing targeted resolution strategies

selected_agents.role: Root cause investigation of liquid level fluctuations
Stability analysis and control strategy development

communication_strategy.information_flow: Sequential diagnostic analysis and system stability evaluation
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated problem decomposition and solution synthesis

clarification_questions: What are the specific phases being separated in the three-phase separator?
Can you describe the frequency and magnitude of the liquid level fluctuations?
Have there been any recent changes in feed composition or operating conditions?
What downstream processes are being impacted by these instabilities?
